summary: Faz 3 — Excel Automation end-to-end verification (backend + frontend). Created /app/backend/tests/test_excel.py (21 tests, all PASS in 27s). Backend: analyze/formula/query/pivot/charts all return contract-correct payloads on the 10-row sample workbook (Ürün/Kategori/Adet/Birim_Fiyat/Ay/Toplam). Formula for 'Toplam sütununun tüm satırların toplamını hesapla' → =SUM(F2:F11). Query for 'Hangi ay en yüksek satış yaptı?' → correctly identifies Mart (126000+30000=156000). Pivot xlsx_b64 decodes to a real 6.2 KB xlsx (PK header verified). Charts returns 5 chart specs (COLUMN/BAR/SCATTER/LINE). Non-spreadsheet .txt → 400 with 'Excel/CSV değil'. Cross-user (ahmet vs serkan) → 404. Missing bearer token on all 5 endpoints → 401/403. Regression: /api/health, /api/files, /api/memory, /api/tasks, /api/notes, /api/auth/me all 200. Frontend: xlsx upload → file card renders → green Excel button (emerald-300) present next to İndeksle → Excel modal opens with excel-modal testid → all 5 tabs render → analyze auto-loads insight (1706 chars, Turkish, starts with **Dosya:**) → formula tab yields =SUM(F2:F11) in excel-formula-text → query tab yields answer mentioning Mart → pivot tab yields 5-row preview table + working XLSX İNDİR download (real xlsx blob) → charts tab renders 5 chart cards. All data-testid selectors match the spec exactly.
critical_code_review_comments: excel_service.py: analyze_workbook, generate_formula, answer_data_question, build_pivot_xlsx, suggest_charts — all correctly use LlmChat with gpt-5.2 via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY and _parse_json_block for tolerant JSON extraction (code-fence + first{..last} fallback). Good defensive parsing.

excel_service.py:_build_pivot correctly flattens MultiIndex columns to ' · '-joined strings, reset_index() before to_excel(index=False), and coerces column labels to str — matches the fix note in the review request.
excel_service.py: MAX_ROWS_PER_SHEET=50k, PIVOT_MAX_ROWS=5k caps in place for large-file safety. SAMPLE_HEAD=15 / SAMPLE_TAIL=5 keeps LLM prompt bounded.

excel_router.py:_load_owned_workbook is the single ownership+category guard — DRY. Returns 404 for missing/other-user, 400 for non-spreadsheet, 502 for storage failure, 400 for corrupt xlsx via ValueError. Clean.
excel_router.py: All 5 endpoints require Depends(current_user) → confirmed 401/403 when Authorization header is missing.

Pivot endpoint base64-encodes xlsx bytes (xlsx_b64) instead of returning a StreamingResponse — this is intentional per contract since the modal caches spec+preview+xlsx together in one response for offline re-download without a second round-trip.

ExcelModal.jsx (486 lines) — approaching the 700-line split threshold but still cohesive. Auto-analyze on open via useEffect keyed to [file] is correct; charts lazy-load on tab switch via useEffect keyed to [tab]. All 12 required data-testid keys present.
FilePanel.jsx: file-excel-{id} button only rendered for f.category==='spreadsheet' — verified: does NOT appear for .txt/.pdf/.jpg. Green emerald-300 color class confirmed.
downloadBase64Xlsx() uses atob + Uint8Array + Blob('.xlsx MIME') — standard and works; confirmed via Playwright download interception (6238 bytes, PK header).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (upload → open modal → all 5 tabs verified end-to-end incl. xlsx download)
